description.text: We are Germany’s most active VC investor, funding deep-tech, life sciences and digital tech companies that secure technological sovereignty and build industrial strength.

targetApplicants.text: We invest in tech founders building tomorrow’s technologies – Deep Tech, Life Sciences, Digital Tech. As a Multi-Stage VC Platform, we back them from Pre-Seed to Growth: with capital, network, and the conviction to invest where it’s early, complex, or long-term. Our mission goes beyond any single investment: together, we lay the foundation for a New Wirtschaftswunder – turning German and European innovation into global tech champions.
